filingFee: $100 standard conviction-sealing court deposit (waiver rules may apply); paid DIRECTLY to Wood County Clerk before emailing/faxing
clerkAddress: Wood County Clerk of Courts, 1 Courthouse Sq, Bowling Green, OH 43402
requiredDocuments: Court-issued Address Verification form and Application to Seal Record of Conviction; omit the two guidance pages
Applicant-signed original document kept in the applicant's possession; a drawn browser signature alone is not proof of a physically signed source
Court deposit confirmation/receipt or accepted fee-waiver evidence, as applicable
Case number and filing authorization; redact protected personal identifiers as required
steps: Verify eligibility, exact case number, current charge outcomes, and official two-page Wood County form.
Prepare the applicant's physically signed source; retain it (and the sent email) through the end of the case and post-judgment remedies.

Unless an applicable fee waiver is accepted, pay the $100 conviction-sealing deposit DIRECTLY to the Wood County Clerk before emailing. Its online Point and Pay portal may assess a separate convenience fee.
Keep proof of actual clerk payment tied to the case. Do not pay the same $100 to RecordPathAI for a Lob check if choosing direct prepayment.

After court prepayment is confirmed, send the non-editable, searchable signed PDF (at most 25 MB) to clerkofcourts@woodcountyohio.gov under Local Rule 3.03(A)(4)(p). Do NOT use Heidi's individual address.
Keep the source document and sent message, check the public docket for a file-stamped accepted entry, and follow up if the clerk does not acknowledge it.
notes: Under Local Rule 3.03(A)(4)(p)*, sealing/expungement applications are exceptions to the email/fax exclusion ONLY when payment was submitted before filing.

The original source document must contain physical signatures and remain available if the court asks. The emailed PDF can show the source signature or the Rule 3.03(D) /s/ notation with the signed paper source held.
E-mailing is NOT the Clerk's acceptance or a docketed filing; the Clerk may decline to acknowledge an email, and filings received after 4:30 p.m. may not be accepted until the next business day.
Never attach a synthetic Lob demonstration, unsigned test PDF, or personal identifiers not needed for filing.
This page provides published rule-based instructions; RecordPathAI does not automatically send filings or process the Clerk's online deposit.
